import json,urllib.request
base='http://127.0.0.1:17448'
specs=[
 ('Media','agent-media','agent/media-r27-real-input-local-rehearsal-20261006'),
 ('Bridge','chat-6ac45836-87a0-83ed-bea4-0ad0f99c8982','agent/bridge-r43-porcelain-cutover-fix-20261006'),
 ('Creator','chat-6ac455e9-bea0-83eb-aa94-fd3dde516c0c','agent/creator-r39-current-authority-binder-20261006'),
 ('Growth','chat-6abf3eb2-40ec-83ed-9f7f-c4a32ad11fc0','agent/growth-r38-real-local-bundle-verifier-20261006'),
 ('Native','agent-pc-control','agent/native-mcp-r39-local-canary-20261006'),
 ('QA','chat-6ac45fb0-9074-83eb-99eb-397265b228e7','agent/integration-r8-final-local-stack-20261006')
]
out=[]
for label,chat,branch in specs:
    try:
        d=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments?chatId='+chat,timeout=10).read().decode('utf-8'))
        rows=[x for x in d.get('assignments',[]) if x.get('branch')==branch]
        rows=sorted(rows,key=lambda x:str(x.get('createdAt') or x.get('updatedAt') or ''))
        row=rows[-1] if rows else {}
        keep=['id','state','lastPreflightReason','lastDiagnostic','dispatchTargetId','dispatchCount','dispatchSubmitAttempted','dispatchFailureCode','currentHead','ciRunId','ciConclusion','supervisorVerified','updatedAt','completedAt','targetChatUrl']
        out.append({'label':label,'chat':chat,'branch':branch,'assignment':{k:row.get(k) for k in keep}})
    except Exception as e:
        out.append({'label':label,'chat':chat,'branch':branch,'error':type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)})
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=True,separators=(',',':')))
